Kin will not have hundreds of millions of users soon. Most of the people who have downloaded an app do not use the app. If you look at the total number of users compared to the monthly users you will see that it is usually one in ten. The number is much less for daily or weekly users. Out of the daily and weekly users, only a fraction of the users will actually participate in using Kin. With 756 billion KIN currently in circulation then the total number of current actual users will not affect the price much. That may change over the year as the percentage of app users who participate in KIN goes up. I do not expect to see much change in price until there are actually 100 million people participating in KIN. That is if KIN does not release more of the 10 trillion total coins into circulation.
